findings.title: vectorElemMinSize is quadratic in nesting depth
findings.claim: At every level of its own recursion vectorElemMinSize calls the fully recursive isVectorVariableLengthType, and unmarshalVector re-runs the bound at each nested level, so a deeply nested server-supplied type (~1400 levels) can make the client burn CPU regardless of actual value size.

findings.title: MaxInt32 saturation branch in the bound arithmetic is untested
findings.claim: No test exercises the saturation arithmetic beyond an inner dimension of 4, so a wrap, off-by-one, or 32-bit narrowing bug in that branch would go undetected.

findings.title: Float fast-path length-mismatch check is no longer exercised by tests
findings.claim: Existing wrong-length tests are now caught by the new bound first and only assert that some error occurred, so removing the fast-path len(data) != expected checks would still pass all tests (e.g. 28 bytes into *[]float64 with 3 dimensions would decode without error).

findings.title: PR body overstates that every new test fails against pristine code
findings.claim: Several new tests (TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads, TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType, and two 'still decodes' subtests) assert behaviour the base code already has, contradicting the claim that every new test fails against pristine marshal.go/helpers.go.

findings.title: Bound's comment inaccurately claims every path allocates
findings.claim: The comment says 'every path below turns it into an allocation', but the *[N]T array path allocates nothing, which the PR's own test comment acknowledges.

findings.title: Test comment states wrong byte size for inner vector
findings.claim: A comment says each inner vector<text,3> is 'eight bytes', but each one is actually 4 bytes; 8 is the size of the whole two-element payload.

findings.title: Stale rationale in test doc comment about minimum vector encoding size
findings.claim: The comment argues 'a vector of N elements is never encoded in fewer than N bytes', but the actual bound is Dimensions * vectorElemMinSize, not N bytes.

findings.title: makeVectorType duplicates existing test helper functions
findings.claim: makeVectorType duplicates what makeFloat32VectorType and makeDoubleVectorType already build, and the new tests mix both styles, meaning a change to the vector type's layout or name format must be repeated across multiple builders.

findings.title: Commit 0276a66's message omits mention of vectorElemMinSize
findings.claim: A candidate claim that the commit message for 0276a66 leaves out vectorElemMinSize was raised but rejected by Codex during adjudication.

findings.title: Missing AI attribution trailer
findings.claim: A lead claiming an AI attribution trailer was missing was screened out because it relied on a private user rule rather than a repository rule, and CONTRIBUTING.md has no such rule.
